about.title: About me
about.lead: I’m a final-year Computer Science Engineering student at ENSAF in Fès. I began by teaching myself programming from scratch: algorithms on paper, then C, C++, and C#.
about.body: Today I build and ship production systems for clients across healthcare, retail and point of sale, marketplaces, and restaurant operations. I enjoy turning complex workflows and data into software people can rely on. I’m now looking for a 6-month PFE internship.
